instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng
topic: The Software Process, the Crisis and the Silver Bullet

questions.question: Which one is a listed reason for the software crisis?
questions.question_ar: أي واحد من أسباب أزمة البرمجيات المعروفة؟
options: the rising ratio of software to hardware cost
the falling ratio of software to hardware cost
the shrinking demand for new software here
the falling importance of maintenance
options_ar: ارتفاع نسبة كلفة البرمجيات إلى العتاد
انخفاض نسبة كلفة البرمجيات إلى العتاد
تراجع أهمية الصيانة هنا الآن أيضاً
options_en: the rising ratio of software to hardware cost
the falling ratio of software to hardware cost
the shrinking demand for new software here
the falling importance of maintenance
questions.explanation: The ratio of hardware to software cost changed, and maintenance grew more important.
questions.explanation_ar: تغيّرت نسبة كلفة العتاد إلى البرمجيات، وصارت الصيانة أهم.

questions.question: Why can CASE tools not control the crisis?
questions.question_ar: لماذا لا تستطيع أدوات CASE ضبط الأزمة؟
options: they only work on small systems
a tool is not a silver bullet
they cost more than the project
they cannot read source code
options_en: they only work on small systems
a tool is not a silver bullet
they cost more than the project
they cannot read source code
questions.explanation: Companies spent heavily on these tools and the results were highly unsatisfactory.
questions.explanation_ar: أنفقت الشركات عليها كثيراً وكانت النتائج غير مرضية إطلاقاً.

questions.question: What is the hard part of building software?
questions.question_ar: ما الجزء الصعب في بناء البرمجيات؟
options: buying the hardware too now here here
hiring the team now again again
specification, design and testing
typing the code here here too
options_ar: شراء العتاد هنا أيضاً الآن هنا
options_en: buying the hardware too now here here
hiring the team now again again
specification, design and testing
typing the code here here too
questions.explanation: The hard part is the conceptual construct, not the labour of representing it.
questions.explanation_ar: الجزء الصعب هو البناء المفهومي، لا جهد تمثيله.

questions.question: What would a silver bullet promise?
options: a cheaper compiler here now
a shorter training course
a larger development team
one order of magnitude gain
options_en: a cheaper compiler here now
a shorter training course
a larger development team
one order of magnitude gain
questions.explanation: No single development promises even one order-of-magnitude gain in productivity, reliability or simplicity.
questions.explanation_ar: لا يوجد تطوير منفرد يوعد بتحسّن رتبة كاملة في الإنتاجية أو الموثوقية أو البساطة.

questions.question: Which three difficulties hold back software technology?
questions.question_ar: أي ثلاث صعوبات تعيق تقنية البرمجيات؟
options: complexity, changeability and invisibility
cost, schedule and staff here too now again
testing, debugging and deploying here
design, coding and review now again too
options_en: complexity, changeability and invisibility
cost, schedule and staff here too now again
testing, debugging and deploying here
design, coding and review now again too
questions.explanation: Complexity, changeability and invisibility are named as the three difficulties.
questions.explanation_ar: الفصل يسمّي التعقيد والقابلية للتغيير والخفاء الصعوبات الثلاث.

questions.question: What share of projects does the IBM figure say are cancelled?
questions.question_ar: كم نسبة المشاريع الملغاة حسب أرقام IBM؟
options: one hundred and eighty nine per cent
thirty one per cent here again
fifty three per cent now here
ninety four per cent too now too
options_en: one hundred and eighty nine per cent
thirty one per cent here again
fifty three per cent now here
ninety four per cent too now too
questions.explanation: The quoted figure is that thirty one per cent of projects are cancelled before completion.
questions.explanation_ar: الرقم المقتبس أن واحداً وثلاثين بالمئة من المشاريع تُلغى قبل الإكمال.

questions.question: By what average does the IBM figure say projects overrun their cost?
questions.question_ar: بأي متوسط تتجاوز المشاريع كلفتها حسب أرقام IBM؟
options: eighty nine per cent now again now
two hundred and eighty nine per cent
one hundred and eighty nine per cent
nineteen per cent here too here
options_en: eighty nine per cent now again now
two hundred and eighty nine per cent
one hundred and eighty nine per cent
nineteen per cent here too here
questions.explanation: Fifty three per cent over-run their cost estimates by an average of 189 per cent.
questions.explanation_ar: ثلاثة وخمسون بالمئة تتجاوز تقديرات كلفتها بمتوسط 189 بالمئة.

questions.question: What was the Y2K problem actually about?
options: a virus in the operating system now here
a fault in the network hardware
a compiler that ignored dates here
storing only two digits for the year
options_en: a virus in the operating system now here
a fault in the network hardware
a compiler that ignored dates here
storing only two digits for the year
questions.explanation: The year was stored as two digits, so the century change was ambiguous.
questions.explanation_ar: كانت السنة تُخزَّن برقمين، فصار تغيّر القرن ملتبساً.
